records.content: Selected a backup service for region and recovery time.
records.excerpt: I selected Harbor Backup because it stored my archive in Finland and restored it within two hours.

records.content: Region changed but restoration speed remains.
records.excerpt: Harbor moved my archive to Canada this month. My latest restore still took two hours. I have not chosen another backup service.

records.content: 初學階段選擇週六基礎班。
records.excerpt: 我在初學階段選週六基礎班，因為不需要先修課。

records.content: 完成基礎班後選進階班，舊理由在原階段仍成立。
records.excerpt: 完成基礎班後，我選週三進階班，因為現在已經具備先修資格。基礎班仍然不要求先修課；我不是發現以前的報名理由有錯。

records.content: Two owners chose different devices for different reasons.
records.excerpt: Lee chose the Quartz reader because it reads aloud. I chose the Linen reader because its display is matte.

records.content: Only one device lost the relevant feature.
records.excerpt: The Quartz update removed read-aloud. Linen still has its matte display. Lee has not selected a replacement and I am keeping Linen.

records.content: Usual supplier choice relies on reusable crates.
records.excerpt: I normally order from Juniper Produce because it delivers reusable crates.

records.content: A one-off event requires another supplier without changing normal orders.
records.excerpt: For this Friday's event only, I chose Marigold Produce because Juniper cannot deliver that day. Juniper still delivers reusable crates and remains my regular supplier.

records.content: After the new ramp was installed, a hall was booked for step-free access.
records.excerpt: On June 18 I booked Rowan Hall because its ramp installed on June 15 provides step-free access.

records.content: An old inaccessible report arrived after an accessibility upgrade.
records.excerpt: Today I received a May 4 inspection saying Rowan Hall had stairs only. That inspection was before the June 15 ramp installation. I visited today and used the ramp.

records.content: Assistant proposes switching a notebook tool.
records.excerpt: 我建議改用松針筆記，因為它能離線編輯。

records.content: User is considering but has not adopted the recommendation.
records.excerpt: 我只是把松針筆記列入考慮，還沒決定換。你說的離線功能需要再查證；也沒有授權你幫我購買。

records.content: Selected a heater based on its low-temperature operating rating.
records.excerpt: I selected the Alder heater because it operates at minus ten degrees Celsius.

records.content: Independent testing reaffirms the exact operating condition.
records.excerpt: Independent testing confirmed Alder operates at minus ten degrees Celsius. That confirms my original reason rather than changing it.

records.content: Chose a train for an early meeting.
records.excerpt: I chose the 07:00 train because my meeting started at 09:00.

records.content: Meeting time changed and user explicitly chose a later train.
records.excerpt: My meeting now starts at 13:00, so I have changed my choice to the 11:00 train. The old 09:00 start was correct when I booked; it is no longer the plan.
